+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9180'
+title: Give the sandbox probe of the agent to AgentEnvironment.make
+---
+## What
+FoundationModelsAgents main 79f1428 (task ^vn9ejqh, 2026-11-10) adds a last parameter `sandboxProbe: SandboxProbe = .live` to `AgentEnvironment.make`. It goes to both `SkillsTool.make` calls. With `.fixed(true)` and a skills registry in `.open` mode, `AgentEnvironment.make` throws `ToolModeError.openModeInSandbox`. With `.fixed(false)` or a `.sandboxed` registry, it succeeds.
+
+Today `AgentsComposition.swift` ~94 calls `AgentEnvironment.make(...)` with no probe, so the skills tool always uses `.live` and a test with `.fixed` cannot reach it (gap found in ^bwgmkc0).
+
+1. Update only the FoundationModelsAgents pin (`swift package update FoundationModelsAgents`, root and IntegrationTests) to a commit that has 79f1428.
+2. `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Tools/AgentsComposition.swift`: pass `sandboxProbe: context.sandboxProbe` (from `CatalogContext`) to `AgentEnvironment.make`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The probe of the agent reaches `AgentEnvironment.make`.
+- [ ] Composing an agent in `.open` mode with `.fixed(true)` fails with `openModeInSandbox` (it already fails earlier in `compose`; confirm the error is the same and comes first from `compose`).
+- [ ] Composing in `.sandboxed` mode with `.fixed(true)` succeeds, and the skills tool is there.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ToolModeTests.swift`: a test with `.sandboxed` and `.fixed(true)` that starts a session and finds the skills tool. A test that `AgentsComposition` gives the probe (for example with a spy, or by the error path).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
